entities.summary: Rosalind Miles is an English author, historian, university lecturer, broadcaster, journalist, magistrate and activist who has written 23 works of fiction and non-fiction. Dr Miles' international best-selling book The Women's History of the World, also called Who Cooked the Last Supper?, charts the untold history of women.
